SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS marvel_percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';
